page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (top and middle), and a note column beside the lower text; footnotes at the foot of the page.

main_text.p: & prompto aliquo ligno.. E quâ Crux nostri Servatoris ? censemus èChristi è quercu. quercu. Primùm quia viri fide digni asserunt, frusta sacratissi- mi hujus ligni quæ hodie ex- stant, speciem hanc referre. Tum, quia crebra & frequens in Judæâ olim & nunc quoque illa arbor. Tertiò, quia robu- stum lignum & fixioni laturæque aptum. Itaque Silius possis tamen pro quovis ligno capere, more poëta- rum. in eo etiam crucifigit.

p.i: Quem postquam diro suspensum * robore vidit.
Ereẞo suffixum robore mastis Ostentabat ovans populis.

main_text.p: Nam quod superioris aliquot ævi scriptores tria aut * quatuor genera ligni in Cruce dominicâ agnoscunt, curiosè magis dictum arbitramur quàm verè. Cedrum, Palmam, Cupressum, Olivam. At Cruces ubi?

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan; the transcription of the margin notes is approximate. Verse lines are reproduced as far as legible; the line "Quem postquam ... * robore vidit" and the Silius quotation are set in italics. Right-margin notes such as "possis tamen pro quovis ligno capere, more poëtarum" are approximate in order.
